title: EXAM ESCAPE
oneLiner: Dodge flying exam papers and grab lucky pencils before the bell rings.
mechanics: Move the student around one screen while exam papers sweep in from the edges.
Collect golden pencils to score points and briefly boost your speed.
Avoid red-marked papers; each hit costs a heart.
The papers move faster and arrive in denser patterns over time.

controls.a: Dash briefly in your facing direction

lose: Lose all three hearts after colliding with exam papers.
scoring: Each golden pencil collected scores 100 points.
